description: Whitianga Harbour Bathymetric LiDAR 5m Depth Model (2013) is a dataset listed in LINZ Data Service (data.linz.govt.nz), New Zealand, an open data portal, published or maintained by New Zealand Hydrographic Authority. This layer contains depth information in gridded format captured by bathymetric LiDAR in 2013 as part of MSAP LiDAR Trial. The data was collected for Toitū Te Whenua Land Information New Zealand (LINZ) and for which the survey took place from 11 May to 24 May 2013. Data management and distribution is by LINZ. Coverage: New Zealand. The portal files it under the publisher New Zealand Hydrographic Authority. Its tags are New Zealand. It offers 1 resource(s) in grid. The portal shows 2024-09-23 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the portal's own catalogue entry (title, description, tags, licence, formats and dates) read through its API, so the data files were not opened, their contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-nz-linz-portal.
